title: Sentence mining
subtitle: Save Japanese lines from the texthooker and send them to Anki.
shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + M saves the latest line even while another window is active. On Windows, it also captures a screenshot when the linked game or novel is in focus.
deckHint: Anki Desktop and AnkiConnect must be running. Note type and field mapping are configured in Settings.
empty: No saved sentences yet. Save a line from the texthooker or use the shortcut.

errors.lineNotFound: That texthooker line is no longer available.
errors.noJapanese: This line has no Japanese text.
errors.noLine: There is no line in this session yet.
errors.sentenceNotFound: This saved sentence was not found.
errors.deckMissing: Choose an Anki deck and note type first.
errors.ankiModelMissing: Choose an Anki deck and note type first.
